content.title: About
content.content: Cranberry juice blend is a 100% cranberry juice obtained by cold pressing. It has a bright tart flavor, characteristic aroma, and a deep red color. No added sugar, preservatives or artificial flavors.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Cranberries are traditionally cultivated in northern regions of North America and some parts of Europe.
The juice is rich in antioxidants, especially proanthocyanidins, which give it its vivid color.
Cranberries have been used in folk medicine for urinary tract infection prevention.
Cranberry juice is often blended with other berry juices to soften its acidity.
A 100 ml serving provides more than the daily recommended intake of vitamin C for most adults.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Antioxidants help neutralize free radicals, supporting cellular health.

items.title: Supports urinary tract health
items.content: Proanthocyanidins contribute to the prevention of urinary tract infections.

items.title: Source of vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C boosts immunity and is essential for collagen synthesis.

items.title: Anti‑inflammatory properties
items.content: Phytonutrients in cranberries exhibit anti‑inflammatory effects.

items.title: Cardiovascular support
items.content: Studies suggest regular consumption may improve lipid profiles.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity can irritate the stomach in people with gastritis or ulcer disease.

items.title: Allergy
items.content: Rarely, some individuals may experience an allergic reaction to cranberries.

items.title: Drug interactions
items.content: Cranberry can enhance the effect of anticoagulants such as warfarin; consult a doctor if you take such medication.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Drink chilled on its own, add to smoothies, cocktails, marinades, or use as a base for sauces. To reduce tartness, dilute with water or blend with sweeter fruit juices.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the bottle refrigerated after opening. At 2‑4 °C the juice stays fresh for up to 7 days. Avoid direct sunlight.
